release_note_review.surface: CLAUDE.md very long list item startup freeze
release_note_review.reason: Response-only v3 already records reduced symlink-linked instruction reads and does not gain containment. The freeze fix does not change init fields, empty tools, or the text-only contract.

release_note_review.surface: standard-context request over 200K tokens compacts and continues
release_note_review.reason: Response-only does not select a context budget. It still requires one init, one text turn, and one result, and still fail-closes an unknown event type. A compact event on that edge would fail closed rather than widen the text contract. The measured init object is unchanged.

release_note_review.surface: stream-json string escaping of DEL, C1, and Unicode format characters
release_note_review.reason: Parsed values are unchanged. The response-only decoder uses serde_json. Help lines and init fields stay.

release_note_review.surface: mods, plugins, custom hooks, and SubagentStop cadence
release_note_review.reason: Response-only passes --safe-mode. The measured filter still drops installed plugins and keeps only @builtin plugins. Custom hooks and mods stay outside that filter.

Both routes pass -p, so isInteractive is false regardless of the dynamic flag. The builtin availability filter skips the plugin before adding its MCP server; mayConnectMcpServer also requires isAvailable. Response-only safe mode independently blocks mcpAutoDiscovered and rejects nonempty init MCP.

release_note_review.surface: easel builtin also registers for remote_cowork
release_note_review.reason: The extra remote_cowork registration is outside this route. The local e path is unchanged. Empty tools and empty MCP leave easel unselected.

release_note_review.surface: invalid command name leaving claude -p with no output

release_note_review.surface: prompt and agent hook concurrency cap
release_note_review.reason: The scheduler cap applies to prompt and agent hooks. Safe mode still disables installed plugins and custom hooks. The measured filter is structurally unchanged.
